## Main drama so far

This season has been WILD! Lauren and Cameron were the first to get engaged and became the most stable couple. Amber and Barnett also hit it off, but not without some tension along the way. Jessica and Mark faced constant struggles, with Jessica's indecision causing major friction. Giannina and Damian had their ups and downs, leading to Damian saying "I do not" at the altar. Kelly and Kenny seemed solid, but Kelly ultimately decided not to marry him. And don't even get me started on Carlton and Diamond's explosive breakup after the truth about Carlton's past came out!
